description: List your Besidka chats, most recent activity first, with slug, title, project, and whether each is pinned, shared or excluded from memory. Pass search to find chats by title or message content, projectId for the chats of one project, pinnedOnly for pinned chats. Use get_chat with a slug to read one. Requires signing in (chats:read).

limit.description: Chats per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20

projectId.description: Only the chats of this project, from list_projects

searchIn.description: Search titles, message content or both. Defaults to all

name: list_chats
title: List my chats
